title: Rank Six Runs Through
setup: Black's king on d6 and its queen on g6 share the sixth rank, and the squares between them are bare.
hint: Check on the sixth rank from the side that forces the king to step away from its own queen.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qb6+}} checks along the sixth rank with the black queen stranded behind its king. {{Kd7}} is the only legal answer, and it steps off the rank — so {{Qxg6}} simply takes the queen. The prize was never defended at all.
